Ravi: Heads-up  Customer story interview with Meridian happened this morning. need transcript, two pull quotes, and a 45s social cut. embargo idea: 2026-04-20.
Clara: I can do quote extraction & short blog draft. who owns raw audio -> transcript?
Nina: sending to SpeechOps now. will request diarization and timestamps. path will be s3://redwood-marketing/meridian/raw/meridian_interview_2026-03-22.wav
Ravi: thanks. Clara, pick 3 quote options (one conservative) and I'll send to the customer for signoff. Ben, can legal pre-check the claims?
Ben (Legal): quick note: avoid exact percentages unless backed by a snapshot. if they provide a KPI, we need a signed approval or mask numbers. 24-48h turnaround.
Clara: drafting now. tentative quotes:
- "Redwood helped us drop inference cost significantly within weeks."
- "We saw more consistent latency across our EU and US regions."
- "Our cost per request fell roughly 40% after migration."
Clara: will send the first two as primary + conservative fallback; third only if customer provides dashboard evidence.
ClipBot: Transcription job queued. ETA ~90m.
Nina: uploaded diarized transcript + srt to s3://redwood-marketing/meridian/deliverables/ at 2026-03-22T11:32:00Z
Ravi: great. Clara to send quotes to customer today; Ben to review on receipt. Nina please also mark timestamps for a 45s highlight (00:01:20-00:02:05).
Clara: emailed customer with quote options and a short consent checkbox. asked for signoff by 03/24 EOD.
Ben (Legal): got it. will be ready to clear or request edits once customer replies.
Ravi: timeline check: if signoff by 03/24 and legal clears by 03/26 we can finalize assets and schedule the 04/20 embargo. I'll make a launch brief once quotes are locked.
